scientific_integrity: Symbolic formula identities, rational exact Sturm root isolation and branch admissibility have been reproduced within the same mathematical review; finite samples are combined with analytic exclusion of all other transitions. No external audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: This theorem enumerates primitive two-cycles for the real unrounded one-dimensional map at 1/4 <= p <= 1/2. It does not establish higher-period counts, stability of cycles, invariant densities, or cryptographic security. Literature coverage is bounded by inspected sources; independent mathematical assessment is pending.
title: Exact primitive two-cycle transitions in a four-arm quadratic interval map
